messages:
Rae: Quick ping  we have three external guests from ClearLake at 3:30pm. Can reception handle walk-ins or should I pre-register?
Reception: Pre-reg is easiest so badges are ready. If last-minute, we can still do same-day temporary badges. Please send full names + company to reception@redwood.com.
Jun: Also can we reserve 3 seats at the east high-top? I couldn't block spots for guests in the desk app.
People Ops: We can reserve 3 visitor spots at East High-Top once we have names. Guest Wi-Fi: `Guest-Redwood` (24h). If any visitor needs temporary Okta access for a demo, include their email addresses and we can create a 48h guest entry.
Rae: One guest asked to ship a prototype board ahead of time. What address should the courier use and where does heavier freight go?
Reception: Please label shipment: "Redwood Inference - Front Desk
Attn: Rae (ClearLake visit)
[Office street address]". For crates/heavy freight (>25lb) mark as "Receiving" and they will be routed to the receiving dock. Include tracking in your email to reception@redwood.com.
MailRoom: FYI fragile items: mark "Fragile" on the label and include tracking. Heavy pallets need a delivery window so we can schedule dock access.
Jun: Do guests get temporary printing access? One needs to print a two-page handout.
Reception: No default printer access for guests. Options: email the file to reception for one-off printing, or request a temporary print pass (charge to your team).
BadgeBot: visitor_precheck: 3 guests pre-registered by Rae. Badges queued at 15:12.
Rae: Sending names + tracking now. Thanks everyone :pray:
Reception: Noted  badges will be on the desk. For same-day courier drops ask them to ring buzzer "Front A".
